perspective:
From Bradley Ochoa’s subjective perspective, he has access to the following:

- He is a salesperson at a marketing firm; Katherine Lasiloo is his colleague and the marketing manager. Their professional relationship is generally cordial but strained by disagreements over sales and marketing strategy.
- In a meeting room, he prepared and presented data/charts from the last five campaigns to support traditional sales methods. He told Katherine he appreciated her digital strategies but believed core sales could benefit more from traditional methods. He clarified he was not suggesting abandoning digital marketing, but was frustrated that proven methods seemed sidelined without proper consideration.
- He heard Katherine say she saw his point but believed the market was evolving, that digital outreach could not be ignored, and that they should analyze the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, he heard Katherine share recent digital campaign success stories that significantly boosted engagement and sales. He found the results impressive and asked how those strategies were developed. Katherine explained that it was about targeting the right audience with the right message and walked him through the analytics and decision-making behind a recent campaign.
- He admitted to Katherine that he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods, but seeing the outcomes made him want to understand the digital approach more. Katherine said she was glad he was open and emphasized adapting to market trends and diving deeper into data.
- He proposed a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital approaches. Katherine agreed and suggested scheduling time to brainstorm and outline next steps. He felt hopeful and appreciated her willingness to collaborate.
- After the joint meeting, he was excited and worked overtime to prepare a board presentation draft integrating both their ideas. He showed the draft to Katherine. She praised it as comprehensive and well thought out and said his hard work showed. He thanked her, said he was convinced the integrated approach would set them apart from competitors, and said he wanted to nail the presentation. Katherine said she was confident and suggested reviewing it once more to fine-tune.
- After the presentation succeeded and the strategy was implemented, he thanked Katherine, said he had learned much from her, and was grateful for his professional growth through their collaboration. Katherine said it had been a pleasure and that his openness made it a successful partnership.
- He proposed regular strategy sessions to continue their collaboration. Katherine agreed, saying regular sessions would keep them on top of their game and market trends.
